entries.source: Diagnóza dle orphacode. Může být uvedeno více hodnot, pokud se vztahují k více diagnózám. Included in CDE: Yes.
entries.target:
Clinical diagnosis of patient as evaluated at the Rare Disease Centre, as per the Orphanet nomenclature of rare diseases. 

 

This data element is Mandatory 

 

The recommended data standard is the Orphanet nomenclature of rare diseases (ORPHAcodes) via EHDSCondition.problem 

https://www.xt-ehr.eu/fhir/models/0.2.1/StructureDefinition-EHDSCondition-definitions.html#key_EHDSCondition.problem 

 

It is recommended that rare diseases are coded at the lowest (most granular) ORPHAcode available, including subtypes of disorders. In these cases, a diagnosis will be linked to the disorder via the subtype level. 

 

When the condition is not available in the Orphanet nomenclature, it is recommended to: 

Use broad / group codes and one of the non-confirmed diagnosis assertion status (see below) 

Fill in the ‘gene(s)’ field (3.5 and 3.6) if the mutated gene has been identified. 

 

In the case of a rare disorder for which all reasonable efforts have been done by rare diseases experts to determine a diagnosis as per the state of the art and available diagnostic capabilities, but for which this process did not conclude on a clinically known concept, the ORPHAcode ORPHA:616874 may be considered (Rare disorder without a determined diagnosis after full investigation)

entries.source: Stav diagnózy – Ongoing, Likely, Confirmed nebo Unknown.
entries.target:
Current state of the diagnostic process

•	Unconfirmed: There is not sufficient diagnostic and/or clinical evidence to treat this as a confirmed condition.
•	Provisional: This is a tentative diagnosis - a candidate that is still under consideration
•	Confirmed: the diagnosis has been confirmed by a method in the proceeding data element (Method for diagnostic confirmation). There is sufficient diagnostic and/or clinical evidence to treat this as a confirmed condition.
•	Refuted: This condition has been ruled out by subsequent diagnostic and clinical evidence.
•	Entered in error: The statement was entered in error and is not valid.

Undetermined Diagnosis: Note – if the diagnosis in unknown or undetermined and meets the criteria for ORPHAcode ORPHA:616874 as described above, this code is to be used as a 'Confirmed’ diagnosis which is to be later ‘Refuted’ should the diagnostic status evolve.

entries.source: Způsob potvrzení diagnózy: Clinical, Genetic, Biochemical, Biological, Imaging, Functional Exploration, Pathological anatomy, Other. (dotaz na autory: definovat rozdíl mezi 'biochemical' a 'biological').
entries.target:
What diagnostic method was used to confirm the diagnosis .

This data element is Not Mandatory, but is Strongly Recommended.
It should only be used if the”Confirled” value was selected in Diagnosis assertion status

The recommended data standard is LOINC. LOINC codes encompassing the following will ideally be utilised.

•	Clinical: the diagnosis is based on the symptoms and signs manifested by the patient that encompass their general condition.
•	Genetic testing: diagnosis via any molecular biology or cytogenetic examination to detect abnormalities in genetic material (chromosomes, genes, etc.).
•	Biochemical:  diagnosis via the analysis of the chemical parameters of blood, urine, secretions, or other biochemical samples etc.
•	Biological: diagnosis via any other biological examination not related to genetic testing or biochemistry.
•	Imaging: diagnosis via any visual presentation of the structures or functions of organs or bodily tissues, e.g., radiological examinations.
•	Functional exploration: diagnosis via an examination that assesses how an organ performs its function. Includes measurement of physiological and metabolic responses to physical and chemical stimuli (e.g., EMG, ECG, etc).
•	Pathological Anatomy: analysis of cells or tissues; includes microscopy (histology, biopsies) and ultramicroscopy.
•	Other: any other examination that cannot be classified under the diagnostic confirmation methods listed above. To be specified in the text field.
